title: Junior Clerk, Stenographer, Driver, Peon and Other Posts Recruitment 2026
organization: Akola Nagar Parishad / Collectorate Office Akola
salary_range: Pay Matrix Level S-1 to S-8 (Rs. 15,000 - Rs. 89,100)
application_fee: Rs. 1000 for Open Category, Rs. 900 for Reserved Categories, and Free for Ex-Servicemen
age_limit: 18 to 38 years for Open Category; 18 to 43 years for Reserved/EWS categories (relaxations as per rules)
summary: Collectorate Office Akola has announced recruitment for 103 Group-C and Group-D posts across various Nagar Parishads and Nagar Panchayats in Akola district. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official portal akola.gov.in by 2026-12-17. Selection involves an online Computer Based Test (CBT).
eligibility_bullets: Candidates must hold the required educational qualifications such as 10th Pass, ITI, Diploma, or Graduation depending on the post.
Must have adequate knowledge of Marathi language.
Age limits range from 18 to 38/43 years with applicable relaxations for reserved categories.
how_to_apply_steps: Read the detailed advertisement and ensure eligibility for the desired post.
Fill out the online application form and upload necessary scanned documents in PDF format.
Pay the applicable examination fee online before the deadline.
Submit the application form and take a printout for future reference.
pay_level: Pay Matrix Level S-1 to S-8
